requirement: The `habeas` skill's reference on distributed requirements MUST give the guidance of {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.when`, {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.queries`, {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.site_text`, and {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.reviews` as a list of things to do and a list of things not to do.
rationale:
`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.lists` says the `habeas` skill's distributed-requirements reference must give the guidance of the `when`, `queries`, `site_text` and `reviews` requirements as a list of things to do and a list of things not to do. The reference is `assets/skills/habeas/references/distributed-requirements.md`, and it has `## Do` and `## Don't` sections. The test `fn[bundled_skills_give_distributed_guidance_as_do_and_dont_lists]` in `tests/authoring_cli.rs` checks this in two ways.

**Structure**
- It splits out each of the `## Do` and `## Don't` sections.
- It requires at least two top-level `- ` items in each.
- Every `## Don't` item must start with `- Don't `.
- No `## Do` item may start with `- Don't `.

**Placement of the four requirements' guidance**
- `when`: the Do list must contain "Make a requirement distributed only when" and "Separate obligations each site upholds". The second covers marking `{impl}` on code that carries out obligations the sites don't uphold.
- `queries`: the Do list must contain "Write a violation query", "Give every query `match` and `no_match` snippets", and the check that the site queries "select every place the obligation applies and no others".
- `site_text`: the Do list must contain "Describe sites exactly as the site queries select them". The Don't list must contain "Don't describe sites more broadly" and "Don't state a per-site obligation".
- `reviews`: the Don't list must contain "Don't reference the distributed requirement from a site" and "Don't re-run a false site review for a different result". The Do list must contain "Let `habeas author --all` author the site reviews."

The assertions use `section` and `assert_text`, which fail with a labelled message if a phrase is missing. If an item moved to the wrong list, the test would fail, because the phrases are checked against each list separately. The prefix checks would also catch a Do item written as a "Don't" item, and the reverse.

**What the test leaves to other tests**
- Some sub-clauses inside the items are not asserted here. Examples are the convention-as-obligation sentence in the "Describe sites exactly" bullet and the "tighten the queries or the text" part of the re-run bullet.
- Those belong to the content requirements. Each of them has its own marked test: `fn[bundled_skills_make_a_requirement_distributed_only_for_per_site_obligations]`, `fn[bundled_skills_direct_exact_site_queries_violation_queries_and_snippets]`, `fn[bundled_skills_describe_sites_as_queries_select_them_with_checkable_obligations]` and `fn[bundled_skills_explain_site_references_and_site_reviews]`.
- The `lists` obligation is about form: the guidance appears as a Do list and a Don't list. The test covers that for every piece of guidance the four requirements name.

I found no unacknowledged gap and no missing `{test}` marking.

text: The `habeas` skill's reference on distributed requirements MUST give the guidance of {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.when`, {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.queries`, {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.site_text`, and {cite}`requirements.cli.distributed_guidance.reviews` as a list of things to do and a list of things not to do.

The bundled skills MUST direct agents to make a requirement distributed only when its obligation applies on its own at each of many sites, such as a convention every validation function follows; to use `{impl}` instead when particular code carries out the requirement as a whole; and to mark with `{impl}` the code that carries out any obligation of a distributed requirement that its sites do not uphold.

The bundled skills MUST direct agents to write site queries that select every place the obligation applies and no others, violation queries for every kind of construct that could break it, and, for every query, `match` and `no_match` snippets that test its conditions.

The bundled skills MUST direct agents to describe sites exactly as the site queries select them, to state as an obligation any convention the queries rely on, such as how a list is named, and to state only per-site obligations that a reviewer can check from the site and the helpers it calls.

The bundled skills MUST tell agents that sites need no reference to the requirement, that `habeas author --all` authors site reviews under {cite}`requirements.references.site_review`, and that a false site review is addressed by fixing the site, or by tightening the queries or the requirement text when the site should not be covered or the text admits more than one reading, under {cite}`requirements.cli.flip_guidance`, not by re-running the review.
